verdict.rationale: CDP documents conversion between fiat and stablecoin inside custodial accounts: liquidation-style deposit destinations auto-convert incoming USDC to USD, and a guide covers funding a USD treasury and paying out USDC, both via the CLI or SDK. These conversions are tied to inbound deposits and outbound payouts, not a documented standalone internal transfer or rebalancing operation between balances. Missing for 10: an explicit internal transfer/rebalance endpoint between fiat and stablecoin balances, any dashboard workflow, end-to-end treasury rebalancing documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can move value between fiat and stablecoin balances on the platform — internal transfers and rebalancing through the API or dashboard, documented end to end

citations.quote: Accept customer USDC, auto-convert it to USD, and collect it in your treasury, with the CDP CLI or SDK.
Fund a USD treasury and pay out USDC onchain to any wallet, with the CDP CLI or SDK.
A destination can also act as a liquidation address, automatically converting incoming funds into a different asset before crediting the account.
